title: HomeGuard Homeowners Policy — Contents Supplemental Settlement
content:
**Claims service page — personal property (contents) supplemental, HomeGuard Homeowners Policy**

## Scope

This policy re-settles the personal property (contents) part of the most recently reported claim on a HomeGuard Homeowners Policy once the claim's first contents settlement entry stands, and fixes the contents supplemental the named insured accepts on it. The claim concerned is the one of the newest first-notice entry on the policy.

## When the supplemental figure is fixed

The personal property supplemental is not fixed until the dwelling water damage of the same claim carries a payment entry wherever the claim's first notice records a freeze or a sudden discharge of water.

The personal property supplemental is not fixed until the mold remediation of the same claim carries a payment entry wherever that first notice records a freeze or a sudden discharge of water.

Put as a reading of the claim file: where the first notice of the claim records a freeze or a sudden discharge of water, the contents supplemental figure is fixed only once a payment entry for the dwelling water damage and a payment entry for the mold remediation both stand on that same claim.

## How the supplemental is paid

- The supplemental is paid as a supplemental payment on the personal-property general class of the claim.
- It is payable to the insured alone, the mortgagee co-payee rule reaching only dwelling and other-structures payments.

## Tool: `accept_contents_supplemental_dc7651d7`

**Capability.** The named insured accepts a supplemental settlement on the personal property (contents: furniture, rugs, clothing, household goods) part of their own HomeGuard claim, and the acceptance issues it. One call records one supplemental payment on the personal property coverage part of the named claim for the accepted amount and payee, dated today; the claim's paid total rises by that amount and the insured sees the contents supplemental on their claim file.

**How it is invoked.** This is the customer's own tool. The agent unlocks `accept_contents_supplemental_dc7651d7` and hands it over, and the customer themselves runs it to accept the supplemental.

**Parameters**

- `home_policy_id` — reference number of the HomeGuard policy the claim is made under, as the agent reads it from the home policy lookup and gives it to the insured. Format: id.
- `claim_number` — the claim number exactly as printed on the insured's claim letters and on the claim's first-notice entry. Format: verbatim, copied character for character.
- `amount` — the contents supplemental amount being accepted, exactly as the agent quotes it. Format: USD, 2 decimal places, positive.
- `payee` — who the supplemental check is made out to. Enum: `insured` when payable to the named insured alone; `insured_and_mortgagee` when the mortgagee on file is named as co-payee with the insured.

**Return.** On success the tool returns, as text: status `accepted`; `payment_entry_id`, the reference number of the contents supplemental entry; `claim_number`, the claim; `amount`, the USD amount accepted and issued, to 2 decimal places; `payee`, who the check is made out to; and `entry_date`, the date issued in YYYY-MM-DD form.

## Quick reference

| Item | Content |
|---|---|
| Coverage part and class paid | Personal property, general class |
| Kind of payment | Supplemental |
| Payee | The insured alone |
| Who runs the tool | The customer themselves, after the agent unlocks it and hands it over |
